other.description: thermal balance equilibrium used to explore modeling accuracy; BCC structure model maintained a stable structure

evidence.quote: The thermal balance equilibrium was used to explore the modeling accuracy. As shown in Fig. 2, after the heat treatment, the FCC model presented grain shrinkage behavior because of the insufficient attraction force between the atoms. In comparison, the BCC structure model maintained a stable structure and exhibited no grain shrinkage during the thermal equilibrium process.

The strain rate was fixed as 10^8 s^-1 along the Y-axis and the time step was 1 fs at 300 K during the tensile process. The boundaries in three dimensions were the true dimensions (free-boundary) and the uniaxial tensile deformation of nanowires applied along the Y-direction under controlled temperature conditions.
